Paper: Bifunctional peptides that precisely biomineralize Au clusters and specifically stain cell nuclei
Atomic_Formula: Au25 core; mixed CCYTAT/S shell compositions
Verified_Synthesis_or_Optics: 376 µL 1.06 mM peptide + 16 µL 25 mM HAuCl4; pH ~10; dark 12 h; 1.5±0.2 nm; λex/λem 502/677 nm; QY 11%
Critical_Caveat: Do not misread Au25S18-like mass families as 18 peptide ligands.

Paper: RGD peptide-modified fluorescent gold nanoclusters as highly efficient tumor-targeted radiotherapy sensitizers
Atomic_Formula: Not encoded as atomically precise in v0.6
Verified_Synthesis_or_Optics: 1.5 mL peptide 5 mM + 100 µL HAuCl4 25 mM; pH 12–13; 50°C; >20 h; red/NIR fluorescent product
Critical_Caveat: Later computational Au23 models are not retrofitted as primary experimental nuclearity proof.

Paper: Au23(CR)14 nanocluster restores fibril Aβ’s unfolded state with abolished cytotoxicity and dissolves endogenous Aβ plaques
Verified_Synthesis_or_Optics: ESI-MS 8397.9925 + TGA; cold 18 h pre-aging, alkaline step, NaBH4 reduction, 3 kDa UF
Critical_Caveat: Multi-stage synthesis should not be flattened into a misleading single temperature/time pair.

Paper: Photochemical synthesis of fluorescent Au16(RGDC)14 and excited state reactivity with molecular oxygen
Verified_Synthesis_or_Optics: RGDC 9 mM + HAuCl4 3 mM + Omnirad 2959 3 mM; pH 10; N2 15 min; UVA 250 W m−2 30 min; emission ~770 nm
Critical_Caveat: Shares laboratory/platform with W30; lab-aware validation combines them.

Paper: Accelerated size-focusing light activated synthesis of atomically precise fluorescent Au22(Lys–Cys–Lys)16 clusters
Verified_Synthesis_or_Optics: KCK 9 mM + HAuCl4 3 mM + Omnirad 2959 9 mM; pH 11; UVA 12 min; 620 nm size-focus 24 h; absorbance 500 nm; emission 790 nm
Critical_Caveat: Closely related to W29; paper-wise CV alone could overstate generalization, so lab-aware CV is mandatory.
